lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A grid of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly 9 vertical columns and 5-6 horizontal rows spanning the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows of white spots to form a matrix of brightened anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper flank characterized by a sharp high-to-low vertical luminance gradient, extending from the gill area toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of approximately 12-15 discrete high-luminance spots localized within its silhouette, predominantly near the base.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, yellow-tinted pixel clusters indicating commensal organisms near the trailing edge of the pectoral fin and ventral region.
